intro: StorageCafe has no city statistics page for South Burlington. UnitSight's September 2026 street-rate index, from 4 facilities and 40 listings, puts the standard 10x10 at $142 and the climate-controlled 10x10 at $176. StorageUnitCosts and Storage Stats do not publish this city, so the advertised rate is the UnitSight standard figure. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, the six-month average sits above that street rate.
data_asof: Sep 2026 (UnitSight street rates). No StorageCafe industry-statistics page; no StorageUnitCosts city page; no Storage Stats market page. A SpareFoot average dated October 2025 was not averaged in.

units.notes: UnitSight standard street rate $114 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure not published for this size.
UnitSight standard street rate $94 (Sep 2026). No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap).

UnitSight standard street rate $142 (Sep 2026), 4 facilities and 40 listings. Climate-controlled ~$176. SpareFoot's unspecified average of $116.50 is dated October 1, 2025 and is not included in the average.

local_tips: UnitSight tracks 4 facilities and 40 listings in South Burlington (September 2026). Climate-controlled rates were published for the 10x10 only.
Extra Space's published admin fee is $50 on StorageUnitCosts' fee notes, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
